subject: English Home Language

source.subtopic: Group guided: reads aloud from own book with the group; builds sight vocabulary

show.line: Some words we just know by sight. I. The. Is. Let's read them fast!

rounds.prompt: Tap the word that says is.
Tap the word that says the.
Now read the whole sentence to me.

hints: Look at the whole word. You have seen it before!
Point to each word as you read.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will read this card.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! That card says is, not the.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's look together. i, s. That card says is!

parent_line: Can read the sight words the, is, in, on and I.
